name: yapa
description: Persistent, team-shareable memory and tasks for Claude Code: per-prompt recall, teammate sync through the YAPA sync service (Google sign-in), journal and compaction capture.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your name in task IDs and on everything you sync. With the sync service it comes from your Google account and this is informational. Empty = your OS login name.

storage.title: Storage backend
storage.description: 'local' = embedded store, no server needed. 'chroma' = a ChromaDB server at the URL below.

project_roots.title: Project roots
project_roots.description: Comma-separated folders whose subfolders are projects/customers, e.g. ~/work. A session in ~/work/acme uses the project-acme (or customer-acme) collection. Empty = everything is 'global'.

customers.title: Customer folders
customers.description: Comma-separated folder names under a project root that are customers (customer-{name} instead of project-{name}).

sync_enabled.title: Team sync
sync_enabled.description: Share memories and tasks with your team through the YAPA sync service.

sync_service_url.title: Sync service URL
sync_service_url.description: URL of the YAPA sync service, e.g. https://<your-service>.run.app. Sign in once with `gcloud auth login`; no database credentials are needed.

sync_database_url.title: Sync database URL (advanced)
sync_database_url.description: Advanced/self-host: direct database URL (ignored when a service URL is set)

sync_ca_cert.title: Sync database CA certificate
sync_ca_cert.description: Advanced/self-host (direct database only): PEM file with the database server CA; the server certificate is verified against it.

response_capture.title: Auto-capture findings
response_capture.description: After each turn, a small model (claude -p haiku, or your configured curation provider) stores durable findings as 'auto-capture' memories.
